coach.title: AI Coach
coach.subtitle: Personalized recommendations based on your training data
coach.initialMessage:
Hi! I'm your personal AI trainer 💪

I analyze your training data and give you concrete, personalized recommendations. Ask me a question about your training!
coach.q1: How has my training progressed over the last few weeks?
coach.q3: Why am I stalling on bench press?
coach.q4: How much volume am I doing per week?
coach.inputPlaceholder: Ask your AI coach… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)

repCounter.title: Rep Counter
repCounter.subtitle: Experimental rep counting from pose landmarks. Accuracy depends on camera angle and lighting.
repCounter.privacy: The camera runs locally in your browser. No video is uploaded or stored.
repCounter.noCameraSupport: Your browser does not support camera access. Try the latest Chrome, Edge or Firefox on a desktop, over HTTPS or localhost.
repCounter.cameraBlocked: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera for this site in your browser settings and try again.
repCounter.noCameraFound: No camera found. Connect a webcam and try again.
repCounter.cameraInUse: The camera is already in use by another app. Close it and try again.
repCounter.startFailed: Could not start the camera or pose model.
repCounter.safetyMid: It detects basic joint-angle patterns from your camera but cannot guarantee safe technique. It is not medical advice and does not prevent injuries. Use light weight first, and
repCounter.safetyStop: stop immediately if you feel pain, dizziness, chest pain, or unusual shortness of breath
repCounter.tip1: Stand so your full body (or arm) is in frame, side-on.
repCounter.tip2: Good lighting keeps tracking above 15 FPS.
repCounter.tip3: The counter auto-picks your more visible side.

progress.title: Progress
progress.subtitle: Visualize your strength, training volume and body-weight trends over time.
progress.strengthCurveSub: Top weight lifted per session, with your personal record highlighted.
progress.enterTarget: Enter a target weight greater than 0.
progress.cannotRegression: Cannot estimate — recent trend is downward. Address recovery first.
progress.cannotFlat: Cannot estimate — slope is essentially flat. Build momentum first.
progress.plateauBody: your weekly progression is essentially flat. Consider a deload, a program switch, or revisiting form.
progress.regressionBody: you're getting weaker on this lift. Check recovery, sleep, nutrition and form before adding load. If this persists, deload or pause this exercise.
progress.noWeightedSets: No weighted sets logged for this exercise yet.
progress.weeklyVolumeSub: Total weight moved per week (sets × reps × weight), last 8 weeks.
progress.bodyWeightTrendSub: Log your body weight to track it over time (stored on this device).
progress.noBodyWeight: No body-weight entries yet. Add one above to start your trend.
